evidence.note: DecodeWithDiff wires the typed contract (lensoutput.ValidatePayload against the reviewed diff) into the production review-lenses kind; record-time Decode at kind.go:411 is shape-check-only, and machine.go:1029 discards its return, so no findings are lost.

DiffDecoder/WarningEmitter interfaces and decodeKind helper; machine.go:731 confirms the apply path prefers DecodeWithDiff with the recomputed nodeDiff and emits Warnings() as run warn events between NodeOutput and DeltaApplied.
ValidatePayload never errors or panics; malformed/out-of-diff/below-floor entries are bucketed and counted; null-findings silent-poison shape is schema-bucketed so the LENS_VALIDATE warn fires.

New tests pin the apply-path wiring: DiffDecoder used at apply time, warn events emitted exactly once, apply-time nodeDiff failure surfaces, and warn-append store failure surfaces instead of being swallowed.

Corpus fixture exists and its hunks (handlers.go 12-25/63-69/106-153, users.go 37-46 rename, polls.jsx 40-50/93-100) were manually cross-checked against every corpus.json case's expected bucket — all 14 cases land in their pinned buckets.

CLI harness updated to the typed findings format with a real f.go reviewable change and --base wiring (mockInit, cli_test.go:172) so anchor-gated payloads survive the discover diff; all init call sites updated, no stale mockInit remains.

findings.note: AnchorMap's header-pairing check stops a single-line to-header forgery but accepts two adjacent crafted diff lines (a deleted line rendering as '--- a/…' followed by an added line rendering as '+++ b/…') that can mis-attribute later hunks to a phantom file. Documented in-source as a deliberately accepted residual (threat model is accidental corruption, not adversarial construction) and pinned by test; consistent with the package's pre-LLM deterministic-gate role. Non-blocking.

Record-time Decode no longer rejects entry-level contract violations: 'metareview record node-output' accepts a findings payload whose entries are entirely garbage, and the rejection accounting (LENS_VALIDATE warn) only fires later at the apply/advance step. This is the documented two-layer design (record-time shape check, apply-time bucketing where the diff is in hand), and a payload never recorded in a valid shape cannot skip the gate — but an operator inspecting only the record step sees success for garbage entries. Non-blocking, telemetry surfaces it at apply.
